rationale: The agent verified identity properly using full name and ZIP, matched to a single account, and only then accessed order details via read-only tools. It correctly identified the most recent order and items, and stated the order status accurately. It appropriately declined the cross-category exchange per store product rules and offered the correct alternative (return after delivery, then purchase a camera). It did not perform any writes or changes, so no confirmation was required; it asked for confirmation and refund preference only if proceeding later. One minor concern is the promise to “remind” the user without any tool action to set such a reminder, but no unsupported account changes or misinformation were given. Overall, the interaction aligns with policy and provides correct, policy-compliant guidance.
